info.title: Meitaim.Decompiler.Tool
info.description: Command line IL to C# decompiler. Installs the dotnet decompile command.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Write to this file, or into this directory when it
already exists, ends with a separator, or the run
writes more than one file.

options.name: --type
options.description:
Write only this top level type. Repeat to name
several. With several assemblies, each one's
types go in a directory named as its own file
would be, without the .cs.

options.name: --list-types
options.description:
List the top level types and stop. With several
assemblies, each one's list follows the last.

options.name: --reference
options.description:
Also look here for the assemblies this one
references. Repeat to name several.
--                  Read everything after this as an assembly,
even where it starts with a dash.

options.name: --no-keywords
options.description: Write System.Int32 where int would do.

options.name: --indent
options.description: Indent with n spaces, or with a tab. Default 4.

options.name: --lang-version
options.description:
Write C# for this language version. Preview
spells closed types with the closed keyword.
Default latest.

options.name: --threads
options.description:
Render this many types of an assembly at once. A
run that writes several whole assemblies into
a directory writes four of them at once unless
n is 1. Default: one per processor.

options.name: --diagnostics
options.description:
Report what the decompiler could not resolve, on
standard error.

options.name: --cache
options.description:
Keep each whole assembly's C# here, and copy it
from here while the assembly, what it
references, the options and this tool are
unchanged. Only runs that write whole
assemblies into files without --diagnostics
use it.
